# Datagrid

> > Datagrid is an agentic AI platform that automates complex workflows and document processing across enterprise systems like Procore, SharePoint, and Salesforce.

Datagrid provides autonomous AI agents for process automation, document analysis, and workflow optimization in construction and enterprise environments. The platform integrates with major business tools and offers SDKs in Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript for developers.

## Key Topics

- Agentic AI
- AI Agents
- Workflow Automation
- Document Automation
- Deep Search Agent
- Procore Integration
- Python SDK
- TypeScript SDK
- API Integration
- RFI/RFP Automation
- Construction Tech
- Process Automation
- Data Protection
- Datagrid Console
- Built World
